TI.P: concerning the authorisation of zinc chelate of hydroxy analogue of methionine as a feed additive for all animal species

concerning the authorisation of Zinc acetate dihydrate, Zinc chloride anhydrous, Zinc oxide, Zinc sulphate heptahydrate, Zinc sulphate monohydrate, Zinc chelate of amino acids hydrate, Zinc chelate of protein hydrolysates, Zinc chelate of glycine hydrate (solid) and Zinc chelate of glycine hydrate (liquid) as feed additives for all animal species and amending Regulations (EC) No 1334/2003, (EC) No 479/2006, (EU) No 335/2010 and Implementing Regulations (EU) No 991/2012 and (EU) No 636/2013
concerning the authorisation of zinc chelate of hydroxy analogue of methionine as a feed additive for all animal species

ARTICLE.ALINEA: The preparation specified in the Annex, belonging to the additive category nutritional additives and to the functional group compounds of trace elements, is authorised as an additive in animal nutrition subject to the conditions laid down in that Annex.
This Regulation shall enter into force on the 20th day following its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.

FINAL.P: This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.

NOTE.P: Details of the analytical methods are available at the following address of the Community Reference Laboratory: http://irmm.jrc.ec.europa.eu/crl-feed-additives

ROW.CELL: Name of the holder of authorisation
Composition, chemical formula, description, analytical method
Content of element (Zn) in mg/kg of complete feedingstuff with a moisture content of 12 %

TI.BLK.HT: Category of nutritional additives. Functional group: compounds of trace elements

ROW.CELL: Zinc chelate of hydroxy analogue of methionine

ITEM.P: Zinc chelate of hydroxy analogue of methionine containing 17,5 %-18 % zinc and 81 % (2-hydroxy-4-methylthio) butanoic acid
Inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectrometry (ICP-AES) according to EN 15510:2007

CELL.P: Salmonids and milk replacers for calves: 180 (total)
Piglets, sows, rabbits and all fish species other than salmonids: 150 (total)

NP.TXT: The additive shall be incorporated into feed in the form of a premixture.
For user safety: breathing protection, safety glasses and gloves shall be worn during handling.
